name: metricool
description: Connect Metricool to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Metricool MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Metricool to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with social media analytics and planning using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Metricool workspace.
Find anything in Metricool that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review social media analytics and planning in Metricool.
